title: Cornucopias - COPI Cafe Episode 14
description:
In this latest episode of COPICafe, Cornucopias CEOs Rob Greig and Josh Jones discuss the latest events from within the Cornucopias metaverse game. Listen to the corn-brains behind it all as they discuss Cornucopias' latest developments. 

Crack open your favorite beverage, enjoy this information-packed chat in the casual, comfy, corntastic episode of COPICafe!

4:54 - COPI Token Marketplace Integration

10:11 - In-Game Tokenomics
12:50 - Growing The Team - Game Environment Artist
15:00 - Mobile Game Tester Onboarding
19:14 - Mobile Game Challenges
21:01 - Very Quick Surprise Guest
21:48 - Rob Shows Off Our New Merch
23:03 - Tea Talk

27:54 - Custom Domes
30:41 - LEAK
